name: Car
headline: length
subtitle: Mid-size sedan (example: 2026 Toyota Camry)
description: Passenger cars come in many sizes, so this page uses one of the best-selling mid-size sedans in the United States, the 2026 Toyota Camry, as a well-documented example. Toyota lists it at 193.5 inches (about 4.9 m) long and 56.9 inches tall. Compact cars are shorter, while pickup trucks and large SUVs are longer.

caveats: This is one example car, not an average. Toyota.com lists these dimensions for the XLE and Nightshade all-wheel-drive grades; small hatchbacks are about a metre shorter and full-size pickup trucks longer.
The specification page was read in a web browser because Toyota.com blocks simple automated downloads.
